cells.requirement: The City Council instructed the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of entities using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on its use.

Landlords are prohibited from terminating tenancies without just cause and must provide relocation assistance for no-fault evictions. Additionally, landlords may not evict a tenant for unpaid rent unless the amount owed exceeds the Fair Market Rent.

The maximum annual rent increase for units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance is set at 90 percent of the percentage change in the Consumer Price Index, with a minimum of 1 percent and a maximum of 4 percent. For the period from July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026, the allowable increase is set at 3 percent.
Landlords of rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance must pay interest on security deposits held for at least one year.
